text:
maria: Heads up — after today's kernel-selection change (merge r3654) we've started seeing OOMs on long-ctx runs hitting the mmap-backed slab allocator. Repro on staging with batch-size=1, seqlen~32k.

alex: ugh, saw a CI perf alert earlier for memory growth on transformer-long tests. did you get a flamegraph?

maria: yes, grabbing now. main signal is huge arena fragmentation and repeated mmap/unmap churn. attaching pmap and a small perf snippet.

maria: ```
# pmap -x PID
00000000     135M rw-s  /dev/shm/kvcache
00a00000      12M rw-s  [anon]
00b00000      64M rw-s  /tmp/model-kv
TOTAL         221M
```

maria: perf top during run shows user-space syscalls on mmap/munmap and madvise hotspots.

dmitri: kernel-selection change? that was supposed to only affect GEMM kernels/path selection, right? how does that touch alloc patterns?

maria: the change added a dynamic tiling path when seq len > 2k. it switches to a per-request workspace allocation that uses mmap for large temporary buffers. we didn't account for the slab allocator thresholds on our allocator shim.

rachel: CI failure logs: "OOM: process killed" on longctx-e2e, but short tests pass. timeline matches r3654 merge. bisect suggested r3654 -> suspect.

alex: I ran a bisect locally. revert r3654 in staging -> memory stable. apply r3654 -> reproduces. so yes, it's causal.

maria: short-term mitigation idea: fall back to pre-tiling kernel for seqlen > threshold, or change allocator to use pooled mmap (reuse mmaps) rather than munmap per request.

todd: is this a rollout blocker for the release today? can we hotfix?

rachel: Releases team flagged it as a rollback candidate. low-frequency but high-impact for customers using long-ctx. I'd say blocker until we have a patch.

maria: plan: 1) revert r3654 on release branch (rachel) 2) open follow-up to replace per-request munmap with arena reuse (dmitri) 3) add regression test in CI to simulate many long-ctx short-live requests (alex) 4) add perf guardrail that fails CI if mmap/unmap rate spikes (maria).

rachel: I'll run the revert PR now and hold the rollout.

ci-bot: [alert] perf/regression: longctx-memory-growth exceeded 2x baseline on staging (build 2026-03-18_12:03).

alex: here's a minimal repro harness I used (psuedocode):
```
for i in range(200):
  spawn_request(seqlen=32000, batch=1)
  wait(finish)
  sleep(0.1)
```
It forces repeated alloc/free churn.

maria: perf record -> perf script shows stack:
```
0x7f... mmap
0x7f... allocate_workspace
0x7f... select_kernel_dynamic_tile
0x7f... run_attention
```

dmitri: I'll prototype pooled mmap reuse tonight. that should remove fragmentation and reduce syscalls. Can we also add a flag to force old kernel for canary?

maria: yes, we can gate by runtime flag: --kernel-tiling=auto|force-old|force-new. I'll add to rollout config and default to auto.

todd: once revert is merged, we should post an announcement to eng-oncall and notify customers who hit the issue. ops-bot can you create a ticket for impacted customers?

ops-bot: Created ticket RW-2026-112: "Long-ctx OOMs after kernel-selection merge" assigned to support.

rachel: Revert PR opened: https://git.redwood/r/infra/!1234 Reverting r3654 on release branch. Holding deploy.

maria: After revert lands, can we run the enhanced CI harness (alex) to validate before unblocking?

alex: yes. I pushed the harness to ci/regressions/longctx-mmap. It will run nightly and on release branches after this.

dmitri: note: there's a deeper issue — our allocator's threshold for handing off to mmap is 256KB; with tiling we create many ~512KB slices. pooled mmap will help but we should also revisit threshold and try to use jemalloc arenas for reuse. Adding to follow-up.

maria: other risk: on Dedicated customers using small GPU memory, fallback to old kernel will increase latency but maintain stability. need to update rollout notes.

rachel: agree. I'll add a note in the release channel and draft customer-facing comms if needed.

maria: action items summary:
- rachel: merge revert and hold deployment (in progress)
- dmitri: prototype pooled mmap + config flag (ETA 24h)
- alex: add CI harness + perf guardrail (ETA 12h)
- maria: add runtime flag and monitor, add test coverage for allocator thresholds (ETA 48h)

todd: thanks everyone. keep updates in this thread. once we have pooled mmap + test green we can reintroduce kernel-selection change behind flag.

maria: adding TODO: record perf counters (mmap/munmap syscalls) to our perf dashboard and set alert if > 50/s sustained.

alex: quick note — also saw a small regression in throughput when tiling + pooled mmaps used naive page-fault patterns. we'll profile that too.

maria: good catch. let's keep the kernel-selection behind runtime flag until pooled mmap + page-fault mitigation are in.

rachel: Revert landed and CI is re-running. I'll update when deploy is unblocked. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: [status] build 2026-03-18_12:19: tests passing on release branch after revert.

maria: closing the rollout blocker for now. continuing engineering follow-ups. thanks all. :pray:
